name: Sabrina B. Schewtschenko
headline: Strategic Advisor  |  Author
summary:
With over 12 years of professional experience - including 10+ years as a strategy consultant and a proven leader of large-scale growth and transformation initiatives - I have demonstrated success both as a full-time employee and as an independent freelancer, particularly for private sector organizations. I excel in developing impactful growth strategies, leading digital transformation journeys, and designing high-performance transformation structures (TMO/PMO), as well as facilitating transformative workshops.
 
Renowned for my strong leadership, visionary thinking, and ability to inspire change, I thrive in fast-paced, dynamic teams that value individual accountability. My career includes extensive engagement with executives at all hierarchy levels- up to board members, investors, and venture capitalists- across European as well as international markets (including the Middle East, South Africa, and Brazil).

Combining an international mindset with entrepreneurial spirit, I launched my own coaching business in 2020, further deepening my commitment to fostering and empowering high-performing teams. I am passionate about driving growth, tackling challenges, and making a meaningful impact.

company.name: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism
company.description:
With the ultimate vision of making Dubai the world’s leading commercial centre, investment hub and tourism destination, Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) is mandated to support the Government in positioning the emirate as a major hub for global economy and tourism, and in boosting the city’s economic and tourism competitiveness indicators. 

Under this remit, DET is driving efforts to further enhance Dubai’s diversified, innovative service-based economy to attract top global talent, deliver a world-class business environment and accelerate productivity growth. 

Additionally, DET is supporting Dubai’s vision to become the world’s best city to live and work in by promoting its diverse destination proposition, unique lifestyle and outstanding quality of life, overall.

DET is the principal authority for the planning, supervision, development and marketing of Dubai’s business and tourism sectors.  It is also responsible for the licensing and classification of all types of businesses, including hotels, tour operators and travel agents. 

The DET portfolio includes Dubai Corporation for Tourism and Commerce Marketing, Dubai Festivals and Retail Establishment, Dubai Commercial Registration and Licensing Corporation, Dubai Economic Development Corporation, Dubai Investment Development Agency (Dubai FDI), Dubai SME, Dubai Consumer Protection and Fairtrade Corporation, Dubai Industries and Exports, as well as Dubai College of Tourism, Dubai Sustainable Tourism, Dubai Calendar and Dubai Business Events.
